channel.title: The Valley Times-News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Valley Times-News (valleytimes-news.com)

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Dean Collins: Blessing Follows Obedience
item.description: Dean Collins links daily writing discipline to Christian discipleship, urging believers to move from comfortable learning to obedient action, where blessing follows.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Bill King: What It Was, Was Soccer
item.description: Bill King recalls Andy Griffith's "What It Was, Was Football" as he learns the game of soccer from the sidelines, watching his grandson play at Glenwood High.

item.title: Beulah Family Day returns next month
item.description: Beulah Family Day returns April 18 with games, live music, a $1 car smash and a Top 20 Car Show at Beulah Elementary School; admission is free, with low-cost food and activities.

item.title: Community center explores aquatic family seating options
item.description: Valley Parks and Rec plans picnic tables at the pool, funded by local business donations and an April 12 crawfish boil; tickets on sale March 9–April 3 at the community center.

item.title: Big trucks displayed at Community Center
item.description: Families can explore fire trucks, ambulances and heavy equipment at Valley Parks and Recreation's free Touch-a-Truck event April 11, 10 a.m.–1 p.m. EST, at 130 Sportsplex Dr.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Dean Collins: The Mountain of New Beginnings
item.description: Dean Collins reflects on Jesus as the new Moses, the Sermon on the Mount, and how the Beatitudes call believers to a countercultural, kingdom-centered life.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Loran Smith: Darien and the Coast
item.description: Loran Smith revisits Darien, tracing its Scottish roots, shrimping tradition, and Blessing of the Fleet while reflecting on sunrises, marshes, and Georgia coast fishing.

item.title: Springwood sophomores help at CHS
item.description: Springwood sophomores visit Chattahoochee Humane Society, helping with daily chores and seeing firsthand how a small staff keeps the shelter running.

item.title: Friends of the Community hosts trash pickup day
item.description: Beulah Friends of the Community will hold a citywide trash pickup March 21, inviting volunteers to meet 7 a.m. at the fire department; gloves and bags provided.

item.title: LaFayette falls just short of state title
item.description: LaFayette falls 54-42 to Section in 2A state final, capping a 26-8 season as state runner-up and area champion; seniors Amilleon Huguley and Cameron Thomas earn All-Tournament honors.
